w: Senior sadhus performed the murti pratishtha and inaugurated the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir in Khanpur.
Shri Manmohansingh, Former Union Finance Minister, met Swamishri and praised the construction of Akshardham in New Delhi.

Swamishri arrived at the Santram Mandir in Nadiad to pay his respects at the memorial shrine of the late Santram Maharaj, who had passed away recently. Swamishri offered flowers and tulsi leaves at his memorial shrine. Then Swamishri visited the office and garland the new successor Shri Ramdasji Maharaj.

After Swamishri completed his morning puja at Akshar Farm (which lies between Anand and Vidyanagar) his car was on its way back to the Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Anand. On the way Swamishri sanctified the petrol pump of Yogeshbhai, a devotee. Swamishri remained seated in his car while Yogeshbhai garlanded him. Then at Swamishri's instruction the attendant sadhus showered the sanctified flowers on the premises of the petrol pump. During this time Yogeshbhai offered cashew nuts, raisins and dry fruits to Swamishri. Swamishri took a single raisin and held it between his thumb and finger. After blessing Yogeshbhai Swamishri proceed towards the mandir. After doing darshan of and offering prostrations to Thakorji' Swamishri started walking towards his room. The attendant sadhu enquired as to why he had held the raisin between his fingers till then. Swamishri remained quiet. Then on asking as to whether it was because he had not done Thakorji's darshan.
Even at the age of 85 Swamishri abides by the rule of not eating anything prior to Thakorji's darshan. Swamishri's subtle devotion to Thakorji is unique and exemplary.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
285 devotees pilgrimaged by foot to the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir from the villages of Mehlav, Torna, Kaletar, Kaliyel, Fatehpura and Swaminarayan Nagar.
Six BAPS youths cycled 70 km from the villages of Nahar and Samoj.
326 boys and girls from the ages of four to ten pilgrimaged by foot from different suburbs to the mandir; the maximum distance being 10km.

Today was Swamishri’s 88th birthday. Due to the terrorist attack in Mumbai (26/11) Swamishri had cancelled the celebrations in Mumbai and at all BAPS mandirs and centres. Swamishri had strictly instructed that no mention of his birthday be made after his puja, and no garlands be offered to him. Swamishri performed his puja according to routine and gave audience to 128 devotees.

In the evening satsang assembly members of Anand bal mandal performed a drama ‘Jivishu Swamine Mate’ to commemorate BAPS Anand Mandir’s tenth anniversary. The drama brought to life the extraordinary stories of sacrifice and service by veteran devotees of Anand.

In conclusion, Swamishri appreciated the drama in his blessings, “The drama presented was most enjoyable because it revived memories about the services of devotees in the time of Shastriji Maharaj. They served with body, mind and wealth in testing times. They served to establish the knowledge of Akshar-Purushottam, to please Shastriji Maharaj and to be blessed with liberation for their souls.”

Swamishri’s health was fine. He did his routine darshan of Thakorji, performed morning puja and attended to phone calls and letters. At 7.15 p.m. Dr Lotlikar took a 2-D echo cardiogram of Swamishri’s heart. The result showed that Swamishri’s heart was fine and there was no reason to worry.
